'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
** [[Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure (2022–present)|Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure]], [[Ukrainian energy crisis]]
***[[17 November 2024 Russian strikes on Ukraine]]
****[[Russia]] launches its largest aerial attack on [[Ukraine]] in months. According to [[President of Ukraine]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]], around 120 [[missile]]s and 90 [[Unmanned combat aerial vehicle|drones]] were launched, damaging energy infrastructure across the country, killing at least seven people, and causing widespread damage. [https://edition.cnn.com/2024/11/17/europe/russia-large-aerial-attack-ukraine-intl/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c206l3qgnx2o (BBC News)]
****Ten people are killed and 52 others are injured in a Russian missile strike on an apartment building in [[Sumy]], Ukraine. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/two-children-among-10-killed-russian-missile-strike-sumy-ukraine-says-2024-11-17/ (Reuters)]
**[[President of the United States|United States President]] [[Joe Biden]] lifts restrictions on the Ukrainian use of U.S. weapons for deep attacks inside Russia, with [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian forces]] planning to use the weapons in long-distance attacks in the coming days. [https://www.reuters.com/world/biden-lifts-ban-ukraine-using-us-arms-strike-inside-russia-2024-11-17/ (Reuters)]
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Palestinian genocide accusation]]
***[[Pope Francis]] calls for the [[world community|global community]] to investigate whether [[Israel]] is committing genocide in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2024/11/18/middleeast/pope-israel-gaza-genocide-allegations-intl/index.html (CNN)]
**[[Siege of North Gaza]]
***At least 72 people are killed, a third of whom are children, in an Israeli strike against a residential building in [[Beit Lahia]], in northern Gaza. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/11/17/israel-bombs-residential-building-in-north-gazas-beit-lahiya-killing-50 (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.asiaone.com/world/dozens-killed-and-wounded-israeli-strikes-across-gaza-medics-say (AsiaOne)]
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**[[2024 Israeli invasion of Lebanon]]
***An [[Israel]]i airstrike on the [[Arab Socialist Ba'ath Party – Lebanon Region|Lebanese Ba'ath Party]] headquarters in Ras el-Nabaa, [[Beirut]], [[Lebanon]], kills seven people, including [[Hezbollah]] spokesman Mohammed Afif. Sixteen others are wounded. Three people are also killed and 29 more injured in another airstrike in [[Mar Elias, Beirut|Mar Elias]]. [https://www.barrons.com/news/lebanon-security-source-says-hezbollah-spokesman-killed-in-beirut-strike-3e3fe86d (''Barron's'')] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/11/18/live-israeli-attacks-kill-111-in-gaza-as-pope-calls-for-genocide-inquiry?update=3333909 (Al Jazeera)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[Tropical Storm Sara]] makes landfall in [[Belize]] after causing flooding in [[Honduras]]. [https://apnews.com/article/tropical-storm-sara-belize-honduras-rain-flooding-f107d30b264401bbcc4bd48d240cc86b (AP)]
*[[2024 Pacific typhoon season]]
**[[Typhoon Man-yi (2024)|Typhoon Man-yi]] makes landfall in the [[Philippines]] as a [[Saffir–Simpson scale#Category 4|Category 4]] super typhoon, three days after [[Typhoon Usagi (2024)|Typhoon Usagi]] struck the country and becoming the sixth consecutive storm to affect [[Luzon]] in the past month. At least eight people are killed. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/11/18/philippines-cleans-up-as-super-typhoon-man-yi-leaves-deadly-trail (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cvg5j1k8w8qo (BBC News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*One fatality and dozens of illnesses are linked to an ''[[Escherichia coli#History|E. coli outbreak]]'' of [[Agriculture in the United States|U.S.-grown organic]] [[carrot|carrots]]. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/health/e-coli-outbreak-linked-to-organic-carrots-leaves-1-dead-and-dozens-sickened-across-the-u-s-1.7113486 (CTV News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*Two people are killed and nine others are injured in two shooting incidents near a [[Second line (parades)|parade route]] in [[New Orleans]], [[Louisiana]], [[United States]]. [https://apnews.com/article/new-orleans-shootings-6c641431f5f7d5ce74fd71782e215575 (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Senegalese parliamentary election]]
**Citizens of [[Senegal]] vote for the 165 seats of the [[National Assembly (Senegal)|National Assembly]] after [[President of Senegal|President]] [[Bassirou Diomaye Faye]] dissolved the parliament in September. [https://www.dw.com/en/senegals-new-president-seeks-majority-in-parliamentary-vote/a-70803840 (DW)]
*Hundreds of people march in a protest against [[Russian President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] in [[Berlin]], [[Germany]], which was called by [[Opposition to Vladimir Putin in Russia|opposition leaders]]-in-exile [[Yulia Navalnaya]], [[Vladimir Kara-Murza]], and [[Ilya Yashin]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/russian-opposition-in-exile-holds-berlin-protest-march/a-70804993 (DW)]

'''Sports'''
*[[111th Grey Cup]]
**In [[Canadian football]], the [[Toronto Argonauts]] defeat the [[Winnipeg Blue Bombers]] 41–24 to claim their 19th [[Canadian Football League]] title. [https://www.tsn.ca/cfl/toronto-argonauts-pull-away-in-fourth-to-beat-winnipeg-blue-bombers-in-111th-grey-cup-1.2206560 (TSN)]
**Toronto Argonauts [[quarterback]] [[Nick Arbuckle]] is named the [[Grey Cup Most Valuable Player|most valuable player]] and [[wide receiver]] [[Dejon Brissett]] is named the [[Dick Suderman Trophy|most valuable Canadian]]. [https://www.tsn.ca/cfl/nick-arbuckle-named-most-valuable-player-of-111th-grey-cup-1.2206569 (TSN)]
*[[2024 ATP Finals]]
**In [[tennis]], [[Jannik Sinner]] defeats [[Taylor Fritz]], 6–4, 6–4 to win his first [[ATP Finals]] [[2024 ATP Finals – Singles|singles]] title. [https://edition.cnn.com/2024/11/18/sport/jannik-sinner-atp-finals-taylor-fritz-spt-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*[[2024 MotoGP World Championship]]
**In [[motorcycle racing]], [[Pramac Racing|Prima Pramac Racing]] driver [[Jorge Martín]] wins the 2024 [[MotoGP World Championship]], becoming the first independent driver to win the title in the [[Grand Prix motorcycle racing#MotoGP class|MotoGP era]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/sports/2024/11/17/jorge-martin-of-spain-wins-2024-motogp-championship-in-barcelona (Al Jazeera)]
